newsitem.title: FRANCE: Accor to name Espalioux as new head - paper.
newsitem.headline: Accor to name Espalioux as new head - paper.

text.p: French hotel group Accor is set to announce the appointment of Jean-Marc Espalioux as its new chief executive by October 14, French newspaper Liberation reported on Saturday.
Espalioux is currently assisting managing director of Cie Generale des Eaux and has been widely tipped in recent newspaper reports to be the next new chief executive.

"His appointment should take place by October 14 at the latest at a supervisory board meeting which will confirm the change in status of Accor to a company with a separate supervisory and management board," the paper said.
The paper said the current Accor co-chairmen, Paul Dubrule and Gerard Pelisson, would remain co-chairmen of the supervisory board.
The change in the group's structure was announced at the company's latest annual general meeting.
The group is due to present its first-half results on October 7.
